decisions.reason: As a 2024 automation add-on close to the firm's core machining offer, it preserves option value under still-limited market feedback and is relatively cheap to carry within the existing sales and service setup.
This incremental loading solution also builds on the established business, so with no clear negative signal yet the firm is likely to keep it on the market while demand uncertainty resolves.

Although this dispensing machine is more distant from the core and likely costlier to support, its flagship status and positive external signal from the 2024 design award make management likely to continue backing it for now as a strategic growth option.
